text:
emily: Bringing up aerith14b (v1) on int4. Short bench shows stable latency but we hit OOMs at high max_new_tokens. Anyone triaged?
raj: saw the alerts. OOMs when >512 tokens, memory fragmentation looks likely.
nate: can you paste the job config + logs? I can run local repro.
emily: logs: ```OOM: allocate failed 1.2GB at kv_cache_alloc()\nslot_frag: 312MB free but unusable\nstack: tailspike after 200 tokens``` ... config: ```model: aerith14b\nquant: int4\nbatching: {max_batch_tokens: 8192, max_concurrent: 6}\ndefaults: {max_new_tokens: 1024}```
zara: int4 reduces memory pressure but increases fragmentation w/ current allocator. Try lowering max_concurrent or enabling slot compactor.
raj: agree. Try max_concurrent=3 and max_batch_tokens=4096. Also set session_cache:true to improve prefix reuse.
emily: running canary with: ```max_new_tokens: 512\nmax_concurrent: 3\nmax_batch_tokens: 4096\nsession_cache: true\nkv_prune_threshold: 0.75``` — kicked off in canary pool now (@ops-bot deployed canary-aerith14b-int4-1742223370)
ops-bot: canary deployment started on pool-canary-3, rollout id r-1742223370
nate: quick bench (synthetic prompts) after change: p50 latency +8%, p95 +12% but no OOM in 20m spike test. Token cost down ~18% vs int8.
emily: good. Quality? any degradation vs fp16 baseline?
zara: ran 500 eval examples: BLEU-like delta ~ -0.6% absolute on long-form; hallucination rate slightly up for prompts >400 tokens. We're within acceptable delta for now.
raj: recommendation: ship defaults: max_new_tokens=512, max_concurrent=3, enable slot_compactor:true, fallback path to int8-v2 on OOM. Add a regression alert for quality on long prompts.
emily: will update model manifest and rollout plan. Action items: @nate run full 2h perf run, @zara run expanded eval set, @raj update defaults & fallback. Thanks :thumbsup: 
nate: on it, ETA 2h.
zara: starting eval now, will post results.
